rule: A source is never a content commission or publication authority. Inspect the exact item, recover the strongest available evidence, bind the claim and date, then route it to one or more earned outputs, each with a distinct reader job.

news_big_question.readerJob: Answer one consequential, durable AI question through evidence, mechanism, competing interpretations and a bounded conclusion.
news_big_question.selectionRule: Create only when a question remains important after the immediate news cycle and requires a genuine argument rather than a longer recap.
news_big_question.compatibility: The machine edition key remains tribune until the content schema migrates; the public name is The Big Question.

dear_miss_jeeves.readerJob: Explain one common recurring AI problem, why it happens, and the smallest useful recovery in Miss Jeeves's warm, practical voice.
transformationRequired: one recognizable user problem stated without invented visitor testimony
the actual mechanism or bounded uncertainty behind the problem
one safe practical recovery with a canonical continuation link
source and freshness evidence appropriate to any product-specific claim
dear_miss_jeeves.intakeBoundary: Pre-generated common-issues bank only. Future visitor questions remain private and cannot enter the publishing queue automatically.

career_work_life_tip.sourceEligibility: The source may be ordinary career, workplace or work-life guidance and does not need to mention AI.
transformationRequired: one specific workplace situation and what is actually difficult
one accurate AI or workflow principle that makes the situation easier to understand
one concrete next move the reader can use
a separately verified AI source or accepted LAiDIES concept for the mirror
career_work_life_tip.rejectWhen: Reject a pasted-on AI reference, a false equivalence between people and models, generic confidence coaching, unsafe workplace advice, or any comparison that does not improve the guidance.

publicationEvidenceContract.reportingRole: Reputable reporting is a discovery, corroboration and context source, never automatic authority for the headline, interpretation, causal claim, study conclusion or impact claim.
requiredBeforeNewsstandPublication: complete independent LAiDIES read before the AIDB comparison
underlying primary evidence and exact claim-to-source map
what the evidence establishes and does not establish
mechanism, uncertainty, real-world impact and headline distortion risk
for research: question, status, design, population, comparison, measures, result, limitations, causal boundary, generalization boundary, funding and conflicts
AIDB cross-check recording agreement, omissions, disagreement and distinctive analysis used, or an honest NOT_COVERED or UNAVAILABLE result
publicationEvidenceContract.failureState: HOLD. A prestigious masthead, repeated headline, press release, abstract or AIDB interpretation cannot substitute for this evidence-decoding record.

sources.name: The AI Daily Brief
sources.bestUse: Fast discovery, analysis and named-source trails across current AI developments.
sources.limits: Scout only. Empty source arrays, named people and summaries are leads, not evidence.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Resolve the exact original and current provider, paper, filing, regulator or affected-party record.
sources.recheckTrigger: Official discovery endpoint changes or provenance becomes unreliable.

sources.name: Ethan Mollick
sources.bestUse: High-velocity practical AI-at-work, education, research and model-use questions.
sources.limits: Newsletter and social channels have separate cursors. Social visibility may be incomplete; preferences and commentary are not product facts.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Capture exact post URL, date and text; follow citations to originals and current provider evidence.
sources.recheckTrigger: Official identity, channel access or affiliation changes.

sources.name: OpenAI Developers
sources.bestUse: Current OpenAI product, API, Codex, model, access and implementation claims, including explicitly AI-linked career guidance when a work choice changes.
sources.limits: First-party authority for OpenAI facts, not independent evidence of comparative superiority, safety or learning effectiveness.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind product, model, surface, plan, region and date; test broad behavioural claims in the relevant product.
sources.recheckTrigger: Release notes, model taxonomy, access, pricing or documentation changes.

sources.name: OpenAI Cookbook
sources.bestUse: Executable first-party examples and implementation patterns.
sources.limits: Examples can age and do not prove general effectiveness or cross-provider applicability.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Check current APIs, model support, licence and reproduce consequential behaviour.
sources.recheckTrigger: Repository, API or example dependencies change.

sources.name: Anthropic Engineering
sources.bestUse: First-party Claude, Claude Code, agent-harness, tool, context, evaluation and safety mechanisms, including explicitly AI-linked career guidance when a work practice changes.
sources.limits: Anthropic-specific mechanisms are not universal and engineering posts may describe bounded internal systems.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind the exact article and current Claude documentation; test transferable practices before generalizing.
sources.recheckTrigger: Engineering index, product family or documented behaviour changes.

sources.name: Claude documentation
sources.bestUse: Current Claude API, Claude Code, model, tool, permission and product boundaries, including explicitly AI-linked career guidance when a work practice changes.
sources.limits: Documentation establishes supported behaviour, not independent outcome quality.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Record exact model, surface, plan, platform and checked date; test user-facing behavioural claims.
sources.recheckTrigger: Documentation routes, model aliases or permission behaviour changes.

sources.name: Google AI for Developers
sources.bestUse: Current Gemini product truth and official machine-learning explanations, including explicitly AI-linked career guidance when a work choice changes.
sources.limits: Google-specific product claims and pedagogical simplifications cannot establish cross-provider parity.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind model, product, plan, region and date; distinguish conceptual teaching from product documentation.
sources.recheckTrigger: Gemini releases, documentation or access terms change.

sources.name: Microsoft AI and Copilot documentation
sources.bestUse: Current Microsoft AI, Copilot, Azure and workplace-product claims.
sources.limits: Product documentation and marketing do not establish independent workplace impact.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind exact product, licence, tenant, platform, region and administrator boundary.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use or Microsoft product and licensing changes.

sources.name: Meta AI research and model releases
sources.bestUse: First-party Meta model, open-weight, research and product-release records.
sources.limits: Release claims, licences and openness labels require exact artifact and independent scrutiny.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Open the model card, licence, repository and independent evaluation relevant to the claim.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, model release, licence or access change.

sources.name: AWS Machine Learning and Bedrock
sources.bestUse: Current AWS AI service, Bedrock, infrastructure and implementation claims.
sources.limits: AWS-specific documentation does not establish comparative quality or suitability for non-AWS users.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind service, region, model provider, price, quota, data boundary and current documentation.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use or AWS service, region, pricing or model-catalogue change.

sources.name: NVIDIA AI and data-centre documentation
sources.bestUse: First-party GPU, platform, architecture and product specifications.
sources.limits: List price, power draw, performance and availability vary by system and configuration; marketing benchmarks are interested evidence.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Use the exact product datasheet and configuration; corroborate market, power and comparative claims independently.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, new architecture, specification, availability or pricing change.

sources.name: Hugging Face
sources.bestUse: Model cards, repositories, open-source ecosystem developments and practical technical explanations.
sources.limits: A hosted model card is supplied by its creator and may be incomplete; downloads and popularity do not establish quality or safety.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect creator, licence, files, model card, evaluation, commit date and cited originals.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, repository, licence or model-card change.

sources.name: AP Artificial Intelligence
sources.bestUse: Independent reporting, affected-party context, public consequences and corroboration.
sources.limits: Reporting is not a substitute for the underlying law, paper, filing or product record.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Open the full article, identify its sources and recover load-bearing originals.
sources.recheckTrigger: Topic route changes or reporting cannot be accessed.

sources.name: Reuters AI reporting
sources.bestUse: Independent load-bearing reporting, timelines, filings, affected parties and corroboration.
sources.limits: Topic-route access is not currently machine-verified; each article still requires original-source recovery.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Verify the exact article URL and recover the filing, regulator, paper, company or affected-party evidence.
sources.recheckTrigger: Before first automated use or when the topic route changes.

sources.name: Ars Technica AI
sources.bestUse: Technical reporting, product behaviour, security and implementation context.
sources.limits: Specialist reporting remains secondary evidence and the topic route needs access verification.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Recover official technical records, affected-party evidence and independent corroboration.
sources.recheckTrigger: Before first automated use or when the topic route changes.

sources.name: MIT Technology Review AI
sources.bestUse: Technical, scientific, policy and societal context with expert reporting.
sources.limits: Magazine affiliation does not make every claim primary; access and topic-route verification remain required.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Recover papers, datasets, filings and official records behind load-bearing claims.
sources.recheckTrigger: Before first automated use or when the topic route changes.

sources.name: WIRED AI
sources.bestUse: Technology, labour, culture, power, security and lived-impact reporting that can reveal an AI-linked career question.
sources.limits: Features and commentary can blend reporting and argument; never lift a career conclusion without evidence and an explicit AI mechanism.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Separate reported fact, attributed opinion and author argument; recover originals.
sources.recheckTrigger: Topic route, access or editorial format changes.

sources.name: The Verge AI
sources.bestUse: Fast product, platform, policy and consumer-interface reporting.
sources.limits: Speed and commentary do not replace official release, access, price or affected-party evidence.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Open official product records and independently confirm consequential claims.
sources.recheckTrigger: Topic route or access changes.

sources.name: TechCrunch AI
sources.bestUse: Company, funding, product, startup and practitioner developments that may affect AI work and careers.
sources.limits: Company claims and funding narratives require filings, primary records and an explicit AI-linked reader consequence.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Recover company, investor, filing, product and affected-party evidence.
sources.recheckTrigger: Category route or access changes.

sources.name: NIST Artificial Intelligence
sources.publisher: US National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.bestUse: AI risk, evaluation, standards, measurement and governance frameworks with practical professional implications.
sources.limits: A framework is not a legal requirement or proof that a system is safe; profiles and versions matter.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind exact publication, version, jurisdictional status and applicable role.
sources.recheckTrigger: Framework version, profile, standard or guidance changes.

sources.name: EU AI Act official sources
sources.bestUse: Primary EU AI law, implementation guidance, dates and role-specific obligations.
sources.limits: Legal applicability depends on actor, system, use, territory, date, exceptions and later amendments; LAiDIES is not legal advice.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Use current consolidated law and Commission guidance; identify exact article, effective date and role.
sources.recheckTrigger: Guidance, amendment, code, standard or applicability date changes.

sources.name: OECD.AI Policy Observatory
sources.bestUse: Cross-country AI policy, definitions, indicators, work and governance evidence.
sources.limits: Observatory summaries and indicators retain source, methodology, date and country boundaries.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Open the exact dataset, report, policy or underlying national source.
sources.recheckTrigger: Dataset, methodology, country coverage or policy record changes.

sources.name: IEA energy and data-centre analysis
sources.bestUse: Energy-system evidence for data centres, electricity demand, grids and AI infrastructure.
sources.limits: Estimates and forecasts depend on scenario, geography, year and methodology; data-centre demand is not all AI.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind exact report/table, historical versus forecast status, unit, geography and uncertainty range.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, new IEA report, correction or forecast revision.

sources.name: Stanford HAI AI Index
sources.bestUse: Cross-domain evidence on technical performance, infrastructure, economy, policy, public opinion and responsible AI.
sources.limits: A synthesis chapter is not automatically the strongest source for every statistic.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact chapter, methodology and cited primary source; date every statistic.
sources.recheckTrigger: Successor report, chapter update or correction.

sources.name: Stanford AI Lab
sources.bestUse: Research discovery and researcher-authored explanations linked to original work.
sources.limits: A lab post is item-level commentary; it does not represent all Stanford research or replace the paper.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Recover the exact paper, dataset, code, authors and evaluation limits.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, new item or source correction.

sources.name: Wharton GAIL Research and Prompt Library
sources.bestUse: Prompting research, task/model dependence, practice design, attributed prompt examples and explicitly AI-linked career guidance when the evidence changes a work practice.
sources.limits: Results bind exact models, tasks, datasets and dates. Prompt examples may require attribution and do not guarantee correct output.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact report or prompt licence, reproduce relevant behaviour and recheck current models.
sources.recheckTrigger: New report, prompt-library revision, model change or licence change.

sources.name: Wharton Human-AI Research
sources.bestUse: Workplace, human judgment, education, governance, creativity and human-impact research leads with explicit AI relevance.
sources.limits: The hub is not claim evidence; business samples and partner reports cannot be generalized to all workers or women.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Recover the exact paper/report, population, sponsor, instrument, date and limits.
sources.recheckTrigger: New report, correction or research-map change.

sources.name: Teaching the Science of Learning
sources.bestUse: Research-grounded retrieval, spacing, interleaving, elaboration, concrete examples and dual-coding design.
sources.limits: Strategies apply differently by learner, subject and format; a single book chapter cannot perform all system-level spacing or interleaving.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind the peer-reviewed review or underlying study and adapt the strategy to the exact learning job.
sources.recheckTrigger: Annual evidence review or a relevant systematic-review update.

sources.name: BetterExplained ADEPT method
sources.bestUse: Optional planning heuristic: analogy, diagram, example, plain language and technical precision.
sources.limits: Author-developed method, not a universal evidence-based sequence. Analogy-first can mislead and must never be mandatory.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Use only the moves that improve the exact explanation; retain LAiDIES mechanism and analogy-limit gates.
sources.recheckTrigger: Annual method review or source revision.

sources.name: 3Blue1Brown
sources.bestUse: Visual intuition, mechanism visibility and movement from concrete representation to technical abstraction.
sources.limits: A communication exemplar is not claim authority or permission to imitate visuals, voice or course structure.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect the exact lesson and its sources; adapt the teaching job, not the surface style.
sources.recheckTrigger: Before first direct use or external recommendation.

sources.name: University of Helsinki AI learning
sources.bestUse: Nontechnical adult progression, practical cases, ethics and possible deeper-learning routes.
sources.limits: A course is not primary evidence for all its claims; access, account, level and licence vary.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact module, update date, prerequisites, accessibility, price/account and licence.
sources.recheckTrigger: Quarterly or course/access change.

sources.name: OpenLearn AI
sources.bestUse: Adult-learning scaffolding, plain-language progression, transcripts and low-friction continuation.
sources.limits: Authorship, licence and product dependence vary; Microsoft-authored items are not neutral AI authority.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact item, author, date, captions, level, licence, cost and current product references.
sources.recheckTrigger: Quarterly or item/access/licence change.

sources.name: Cambridge AI Core Concepts
sources.bestUse: Mechanism and lifecycle comparison across training, generative AI, limitations, data and evaluation.
sources.limits: Researcher framing and examples do not automatically fit nontechnical daily-life learners.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Check exact page date, claim sources, accessibility, audience and reuse terms.
sources.recheckTrigger: Quarterly or documentation revision.

sources.name: Alan Turing Institute
sources.bestUse: Responsible AI, governance, standards, risk, professional use and research discovery.
sources.limits: A hub or course catalogue is not claim-level evidence and partners/funders may matter.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Recover exact report/course, authors, funders, methods, dates and access conditions.
sources.recheckTrigger: Monthly or exact-item use.

sources.name: Data & Society AI research
sources.bestUse: Work, power, civic participation, governance and social consequences of AI.
sources.limits: Social-science findings retain population, method, jurisdiction and date boundaries; not mechanism authority.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Use exact report and record population, sponsor, method, date and limitations.
sources.recheckTrigger: New report, correction or exact-item use.

sources.name: Simon Willison
sources.bestUse: Reproducible cross-model experiments, tools, security and implementation observations.
sources.limits: A practitioner experiment remains bounded to its setup and date.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Capture exact post, code/setup and reproduce consequential behaviour.
sources.recheckTrigger: Exact-item use or monitored feed change.

sources.name: Chip Huyen
sources.bestUse: AI-system mechanisms, engineering trade-offs and professional practice with an explicit AI-work connection.
sources.limits: Technical practitioner analysis may assume advanced context and does not establish provider truth by itself.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Capture exact post and return product, research and benchmark claims to primary sources.
sources.recheckTrigger: Exact-item use or material system change.

sources.name: Allie K. Miller
sources.bestUse: Practical home and career AI jobs, examples and format inspiration with explicit AI application.
sources.limits: Current role, disclosures, product claims, commercial interests and access must be checked.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Capture exact item, disclosures and date; independently verify product and outcome claims.
sources.recheckTrigger: Role, disclosure, access or content model changes.

sources.name: DeepLearning.AI
sources.bestUse: Course-format comparison, instructors and technical-source discovery.
sources.limits: Publisher and course availability do not establish teaching quality, currentness or audience fit.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact instructor, syllabus, date, access, price, prerequisites, captions, licence and sources.
sources.recheckTrigger: Quarterly or before external recommendation.

sources.name: MIT Open Learning AI resources
sources.bestUse: Curriculum comparison, prerequisite mapping and optional technical continuation.
sources.limits: Dated directory; not every linked resource is free, current, beginner-friendly or maintained.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact linked course, level, access, cost, date, licence and current relevance.
sources.recheckTrigger: Quarterly or before linking an exact resource.

sources.name: Stanford Artificial Intelligence YouTube playlist
sources.bestUse: Technical foundations, demonstrations and possible deeper-learning links.
sources.limits: Playlist provenance does not establish each video's instructor, date, captions, claims or current relevance.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact video, author/instructor, date, transcript, sources, level and accessibility.
sources.recheckTrigger: Monthly or before linking an exact video.

sources.name: LinkedIn Economic Graph
sources.bestUse: Dated labour-market, skills and job-posting evidence for AI-linked career guidance.
sources.limits: LinkedIn members and postings are not the whole labour market; methodology, geography and platform effects matter.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact report, sample, period, geography, definitions, sponsor and comparison basis.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, new report or methodology change.

sources.name: Microsoft Work Trend Index
sources.bestUse: Workplace AI adoption and work-pattern leads for explicitly AI-linked career questions.
sources.limits: Vendor-sponsored, product-adjacent survey evidence; samples, self-report and promotional framing require scrutiny.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Inspect exact report, instrument, population, geography, sponsor, definitions and independent corroboration.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, new report or methodology change.

sources.name: Future of Jobs Report
sources.bestUse: Employer expectations and dated workforce-change signals for AI-linked career context.
sources.limits: Employer survey expectations are not forecasts of guaranteed jobs, worker experiences or outcomes for women.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind exact edition, respondent population, geography, questions, methodology and date.
sources.recheckTrigger: First use, successor report or correction.

sources.name: Hannah Fry communication benchmark
sources.bestUse: Communication mechanics: begin with the human question, make an invisible process concrete, move accurately between familiar experience and technical abstraction, retain limits and earn the final insight.
sources.limits: A communication benchmark is not factual authority for an AI claim and is not permission to imitate Fry's voice, persona or wording.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Use the current internal Hannah Fry benchmark and the exact destination job; independently source every factual AI claim.
sources.recheckTrigger: Benchmark, source or LAiDIES explanatory-arc decision changes.

sources.name: Four steps to explaining scientific concepts
sources.bestUse: A concise explanation-planning comparator for audience, structure, examples and checking understanding.
sources.limits: This is a practitioner/book-excerpt method, not proof that one sequence is universally effective or sufficient for LAiDIES teaching.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Use only the steps that improve the exact learner journey; keep mechanism, transfer, freshness and source gates.
sources.recheckTrigger: Annual method review or source revision.

sources.name: Feynman Technique teaching handout
sources.bestUse: Metacognitive practice: explain a concept plainly, expose gaps, return to evidence and revise.
sources.limits: The handout adapts a popular secondary technique. Plain explanation must not erase mechanism, exceptions, uncertainty or necessary terminology.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Use as a practice comparator, not evidence of learning effectiveness; bind the exact concept truth and an explain-back criterion.
sources.recheckTrigger: Annual method review or source revision.

sources.name: Ali's work-life and career discovery leads
sources.publisher: Individual Instagram creators — identity not yet bound
sources.bestUse: Discovery of ordinary workplace situations: carrying context forward, responding to a loaded question, reclaiming an interrupted turn and answering an open-ended interview question.
sources.limits: These are non-AI career leads. Creator identity, exact wording, qualifications, evidence and current availability are not yet bound; do not repost, transcribe or imitate.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Recover the exact creator and item, test the workplace guidance, create original LAiDIES wording, then bind a separate verified AI principle, analogy limit and practical next move.
sources.recheckTrigger: Before any use, creator identification or item/access change.

sources.name: Women at Work archive
sources.bestUse: Non-AI workplace dilemmas, research leads and practical perspectives about women at work that may support an earned AI-mirror treatment.
sources.limits: The series ended in 2025; advice, interviews and summaries vary in evidence, jurisdiction, risk and current relevance. HBR prestige does not admit a claim.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Open the exact episode/transcript, recover cited research or specialist evidence, date and scope the advice, and separately verify the AI mirror.
sources.recheckTrigger: Before exact-item use, archive access change or successor series.

sources.name: Women in the Workplace
sources.bestUse: Dated evidence about women's workplace experiences, representation, advancement, sponsorship, flexibility and structural barriers; also a source of ordinary workplace questions for the AI mirror.
sources.limits: Employer and employee samples, geography, definitions, sponsor and survey design limit generalization. Structural problems must not be reframed as individual confidence failures or AI-solvable problems.
sources.verifyBeforeUse: Bind the exact edition, sample, geography, question, method and finding; distinguish data from recommendations and separately verify any AI comparison.
sources.recheckTrigger: New annual edition, correction, methodology or geographic scope change.
